title: Visual Check and Periodic Inspection for CAPS 1200 EL
overview: Perform a thorough visual check and periodic inspection on the CAPS 1200 EL equipment to ensure its proper functioning and condition.

steps.title: Check the cap
steps.description: Locate the cap on the equipment and verify it is properly attached.

steps.title: Examine the green truck
steps.description: Inspect the green truck component to ensure proper functioning and no signs of damage or wear.

steps.title: Check the hydraulic fluid level
steps.description: Verify the hydraulic fluid level is within the recommended range for safe operation.

steps.title: Inspect the hydraulic filters
steps.description: Check the hydraulic filters for any signs of wear or damage and ensure they are properly installed.

steps.title: Perform a visual check on the electrical component
steps.description: Inspect the electrical component, specifically the gate valve and flush valve, to ensure proper functioning and no signs of damage or wear.

steps.title: Check the fluid level for optimal performance and safety
steps.description: Verify that the hydraulic fluid level is adequate for optimal performance and safety, as indicated by the text overlay.

steps.title: Adjust or fix the valve handle
steps.description: Manipulate the valve handle to allow for pump operation, as indicated by the text overlay.

steps.title: Inspect the piping system or electrical conduit
steps.description: Examine the piping system or electrical conduit closely to ensure it is in good condition and free from signs of damage or wear.

steps.title: Assess the integrity of the machine
steps.description: Evaluate the machine for any irregularities, such as scratches or rust spots, that require attention.

steps.title: Adjust or fix a component using a screwdriver
steps.description: Manipulate the side of the machine to adjust or fix a component, as indicated by the text overlay.
